method: Re-checked against the official SQP and marking scheme PDFs with pdftotext -layout, -raw and -table, plus page renders of the recovered figures.

checks.reason: The published figure 21.png is a greyscale conversion of a page that prints the mechanism in colour (pink C=C bond in step 1, blue lone-pair dots on water), so it is not an unaltered crop and loses the printed highlighting.

The stored official answer adds 'EDTA is an electron donor', which the marking scheme gives only for the visually-challenged variant's part III(b), so it does not match the scheme for this question; the figure is also a greyscale copy of the printed red dashed Fe bonds.
